newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian nickel up, other base metals ranged.
newsitem.headline: Indian nickel up, other base metals ranged.

text.p: Nickel prices extended gains on the metal market on Tuesday, dealers said.

Other base metals however held steady in a narrow trading range. Ready nickel rose by 200 rupees to 37,600 rupees per quintal amid restricted supplies and fresh speculative buying on the back of recovery in the world market.
"Physical enquiries remained low today," one broker said.

Nickel was up by 200 rupees on Monday but was down by 100 rupees last week. Copper was quiet at 11,700 rupees per quintal so did zinc at 6,250 rupees and lead at 4,850 rupees per quintal respectively amid limited activity.

Tin was quiet at 35,500 rupees per quintal in nominal trade. Tin was up by 100 rupees on Monday. But was down by 100 rupees during last week. Aluminium was available at the previous level of 7,225 rupees per quintal.
